name: RB-47 Radar-Visual Encounter
summary: USAF RB-47 reconnaissance aircraft tracked UFO for 90 minutes across multiple states using ECM equipment and radar. Six highly-trained crew members witnessed. One of strongest radar-visual military cases in Blue Book files.

name: Trindade Island Photos
summary: Brazilian Navy photographer captured photos of Saturn-shaped object. 48 Navy personnel witnessed. Photos analyzed by Brazilian Navy and deemed authentic.

name: Father Gill Papua Sighting
summary: Anglican missionary Father William Gill and 37 witnesses observed disc with humanoid figures on top over multiple nights. Witnesses waved at entities who waved back. Highly credible mass sighting.

name: Exeter Incident
summary: Multiple witnesses including police officers observed silent object with pulsating red lights hovering low over farmhouse. Blue Book labeled 'Unidentified' after extensive investigation.

name: Portage County Police Chase
summary: Police officers chased metallic disc 85 miles from Ohio into Pennsylvania at speeds up to 103 mph. Multiple police departments involved. Object demonstrated clear superiority.

name: Westall UFO
summary: Over 200 students and teachers at Westall High School witnessed silver disc land in nearby field then rapidly ascend. Ground traces found. Military arrived quickly.

name: Stefan Michalak Encounter
summary: Prospector Stefan Michalak encountered landed craft. When he touched it, received severe burns in grid pattern. Physical evidence and radiation burns documented by doctors.

name: Malmstrom AFB Missiles
summary: Red glowing UFO over Malmstrom AFB caused simultaneous shutdown of 10 nuclear ICBMs. No technical explanation found. Multiple military witnesses. National security implications.

name: Minot AFB B-52 Encounter
summary: B-52 crew tracked object on radar during nuclear alert mission. Object descended in front of aircraft. Ground radar also tracked. Project Blue Book's final 'Unknown' before program closure.

name: Pascagoula Abduction
summary: Charles Hickson and Calvin Parker claimed abduction by robotic beings while fishing. Both passed polygraph tests. Appeared genuinely terrified. One of most credible abduction cases.

name: Coyne Helicopter Incident
summary: Army Reserve helicopter crew encountered cigar-shaped object with green light. UFO controlled helicopter's altitude, pulling it upward 2,000 feet. All four crew members were military-trained observers.

name: Allagash Abductions
summary: Four friends camping witnessed bright sphere. All experienced missing time. Under hypnosis, recalled similar abduction experiences. All passed polygraphs.

name: Cash-Landrum Incident
summary: Betty Cash and Vickie Landrum encountered diamond-shaped object emitting intense heat. Both suffered severe radiation-like injuries. Escorted by military helicopters. Lawsuit filed against US government.

name: Hudson Valley Wave
summary: Beginning of Hudson Valley UFO wave lasting years. Thousands witnessed massive boomerang craft. J. Allen Hynek investigated. Wave continued through mid-1980s.

name: JAL 1628 Alaska Encounter
summary: Japan Airlines cargo flight tracked by UFOs for 50 minutes over Alaska. FAA and military radar confirmed objects. Captain described object twice size of aircraft carrier.

name: Gulf Breeze Wave
summary: Ed Walters photographed UFO multiple times. Hundreds of other witnesses in Gulf Breeze area. Controversy over photo authenticity but broad witness base.

name: Belgian UFO Wave Begins
summary: Beginning of massive Belgian triangle wave. Hundreds witnessed large triangular craft. Belgian Air Force and gendarmerie investigated. Wave continued into 1990 with F-16 radar confirmations.

name: Belgian F-16 Intercept
summary: Belgian Air Force F-16s scrambled to intercept triangular UFOs detected on radar. Objects performed impossible maneuvers, accelerating from 150 to 1,100 mph instantly. Radar evidence confirmed by multiple systems.

name: Mexico City Solar Eclipse UFOs
summary: During total solar eclipse, hundreds videotaped silver disc hovering over Mexico City. Multiple independent videos from different locations showed same object. Extensive Mexican media coverage.

name: RAF Cosford/Shawbury
summary: RAF personnel at Cosford and Shawbury witnessed triangular craft. Meteorological officer saw object fire beam at ground. UK Ministry of Defense investigated, no explanation found.

name: Yukon Giant UFO
summary: Enormous UFO witnessed by dozens over vast area of Yukon. Object described as larger than football stadium. Multiple independent witnesses across hundreds of miles reported same object simultaneously.

name: Phoenix Lights
summary: Massive V-shaped formation of lights witnessed by thousands across Arizona. Object estimated over a mile wide. Governor Fife Symington later admitted witnessing. Largest mass sighting in modern US history.

name: Illinois Police Chase
summary: Multiple police officers from different departments independently chased massive triangular craft across southern Illinois. Object moved silently at low altitude. Officers' detailed reports were  remarkably consistent.

name: O'Hare International Airport
summary: United Airlines employees witnessed metallic disc hovering over gate C17. Object shot upward punching hole in clouds. FAA initially denied reports, later confirmed after Chicago Tribune investigation.

name: Stephenville Lights
summary: Dozens witnessed massive object, estimated mile-wide. F-16s scrambled from nearby base. Radar data obtained via FOIA showed military aircraft in area during sightings. MUFON extensively investigated.

name: Aguadilla Puerto Rico
summary: DHS thermal imaging captured object flying at 120 mph, entering and exiting ocean. Object split into two. Detailed scientific analysis by SCU. One of best thermal video cases.

name: Chilean Navy UFO
summary: Chilean Navy helicopter captured infrared footage of object. CEFAA (Chilean government UAP office) investigated for 2 years before releasing. Object discharged trail of unknown material.

name: Gorman Dogfight
summary: USAF pilot George Gorman engaged in 27-minute 'dogfight' with maneuvering light over Fargo. Object made impossible turns. Ground witnesses confirmed. Project Sign investigated.

name: Chiles-Whitted Encounter
summary: Eastern Airlines pilots Chiles and Whitted encountered wingless cigar-shaped craft with windows. Object passed dangerously close. Ground passenger confirmed sighting.

name: Mantell UFO Chase
summary: Captain Thomas Mantell died chasing UFO. Last transmission: 'appears metallic, tremendous in size.' Officially explained as Skyhook balloon but controversy remains.

name: Kelly-Hopkinsville Encounter
summary: Farm family besieged by small humanoid entities overnight. Police investigated. Physical evidence found. Witnessed by multiple family members. Classic CE3 case.

name: Trans-en-Provence Landing
summary: Farmer witnessed disc land on property. Physical ground traces analyzed by GEPAN (French official UFO office). Soil showed anomalous changes. Category D (unexplained).

name: Rendlesham Forest
summary: USAF personnel at RAF Woodbridge/Bentwaters witnessed landed craft over multiple nights. Col. Halt memo documented. Radiation readings taken. Ground traces found. UK's most famous case.

name: Betty and Barney Hill Abduction
summary: First widely-publicized abduction case. Couple experienced missing time, later recalled medical examination aboard craft under hypnosis. Star map drawn by Betty.

name: Kecksburg Crash
summary: Acorn-shaped object crashed. Military quickly cordoned area and removed object. Witnesses saw hieroglyphic-like writing. Government denied everything. FOIA requests continue.

name: Lakenheath-Bentwaters
summary: RAF and USAF radar tracked objects performing impossible maneuvers. Venom fighter scrambled, object circled behind it. Condon Report called it 'most puzzling' radar case.

name: JAL Cargo 747 Lights
summary: JAL cargo 747 followed by lights for extended period. Different from 1986 JAL1628 case. Crew reported, FAA aware.

name: São Paulo Night
summary: Brazilian Air Force scrambled jets to intercept 20+ UFOs on radar. Defense Minister confirmed on TV. One of largest military responses to UFO event.

name: USS Nimitz Tic Tac
summary: USS Princeton tracked objects on radar for days. F/A-18 pilots engaged 'Tic Tac' object performing impossible maneuvers. FLIR video released 2017. Pentagon confirmed authentic.

name: Gimbal Video
summary: Navy F/A-18 FLIR captured rotating object. Pentagon released 2017. Confirmed authentic UAP. Object rotated while maintaining direction.

name: Go Fast Video
summary: Navy F/A-18 tracked fast-moving object skimming ocean surface. Pentagon released. Confirmed UAP. Object showed no visible propulsion.

name: USS Roosevelt UAP Swarm
summary: USS Roosevelt pilots encountered UAPs daily for months. Objects described as sphere inside cube. Navy submitted hazard reports. Congressional briefings given.

name: Ariel School Zimbabwe
summary: 62 schoolchildren witnessed craft land, beings emerged. Children interviewed separately, stories consistent. Dr. John Mack investigated. Children maintained stories as adults.

name: COMETA Report Cases
summary: French COMETA committee of military/intelligence officials studied UFOs. Concluded some cases represent extraterrestrial hypothesis. Official French government study.

name: Halt Memo Incidents
summary: Deputy Base Commander Lt. Col. Charles Halt documented encounter in official memo. Radiation detected, ground depressions found. Multiple military witnesses night 2-3.

name: Washington DC Second Week
summary: Second weekend of Washington flap. Objects returned. F-94s scrambled again. Radar contacts confirmed. Largest press conference since WWII held. Temperature inversion explanation disputed.

name: Chicago O'Hare Wave
summary: Following 2006 incident, multiple additional sightings at O'Hare. Employees continued reporting. FAA maintained stance of no investigation.

name: Battle of Los Angeles
summary: Anti-aircraft artillery fired 1,400 rounds at unidentified objects over LA. Objects undamaged. Initially thought Japanese attack. Officially explained as false alarm/weather balloon.

name: Andreasson Affair
summary: Betty Andreasson abduction investigated by Raymond Fowler. Detailed account under hypnosis. Family witnessed lights. Extensive investigation spanning years. Multiple books written.

name: Salyut-6 Encounter
summary: Soviet cosmonauts aboard Salyut-6 reported unusual object pacing station. Officially denied but accounts persisted. Multiple crew member reports.

name: Moroccan F-1 Encounter
summary: Moroccan Air Force F-1 jets scrambled to intercept unknown radar target. Object outmaneuvered jets. Incident reported by military sources.

name: Tehran F-14 Intercept 2004
summary: Iranian F-14 intercepted UFO. Weapons systems jammed similar to 1976 case. Multiple similar incidents in 2000s. Iranian officials confirmed encounters.

name: Norwegian Spiral
summary: Massive spiral light over Norway. Thousands witnessed. Initially unexplained. Later confirmed as failed Russian ICBM test. Interesting case of mass UFO sighting with prosaic explanation.

name: Turkey UFO Videos
summary: Yalcin Yalman videotaped objects over Sea of Marmara multiple times. Close-up videos showed structure. Extensively analyzed. Some claim cruise ship, others unexplained.

name: Colares UFO Attacks
summary: Multiple residents reported being attacked by UFO beams causing burns and injuries. Brazilian Air Force Operation Prato investigated. Over 2,000 pages of documents. Doctor treated victims.

name: Varginha Incident
summary: Alleged crash and retrieval of craft and entities. Multiple civilian and military witnesses. Deaths reported. Brazilian military denies. Ongoing investigation by researchers.

name: JAL Flight 1628 Extended
summary: Follow-up sightings by JAL crews on similar routes. Multiple pilots reported encounters. FAA aware but no official investigation like 1986 case.

name: Washington State Drones
summary: Multiple reports of drone swarms over sensitive areas. FBI investigated. No operators found. Similar to Colorado drone swarms. Remains unexplained.

name: Colorado Drone Mystery
summary: Large drone formations seen over rural Colorado/Nebraska. FAA, FBI investigated. No operators identified. Objects showed coordinated behavior.

name: Chinese Airport Closures
summary: Multiple major Chinese airports closed due to UFO sightings. Official government acknowledgment. Flights diverted. Objects on radar. Limited official information released.

name: Chinese Military UFO Video
summary: Video allegedly from Chinese military showing UFO. Limited verification. Part of increasing Chinese government acknowledgment of UFO/UAP phenomena.

name: Congressional UAP Hearing Cases
summary: David Grusch, Fravor, Graves testified to Congress. Grusch claimed non-human craft in government possession. Historic public hearing on UAPs. Calls for transparency.

name: Skinwalker Ranch Phenomena
summary: Robert Bigelow's NIDS studied ranch with high strangeness reports. UFOs, poltergeist, animal mutilations. Ongoing scientific study. Connected to AATIP research.

name: USS Omaha Transmedium
summary: USS Omaha tracked sphere on radar and visually. Object descended into ocean. Claimed 'transmedium' capability. Radar footage leaked, Pentagon confirmed authentic.

name: Pentagon UAP Video Release
summary: Pentagon officially released Nimitz, Gimbal, GoFast videos. Confirmed authenticity. Acknowledged UAPs remain unexplained. Historic moment in UFO disclosure.

name: UAP Task Force Report
summary: Office of Director of National Intelligence released preliminary UAP assessment. 144 incidents since 2004, 143 remain unexplained. Acknowledged safety/security concerns.

name: COMETA Lac de Chauvet
summary: Witness photographed disc over Lac de Chauvet. Featured prominently in COMETA report as credible photographic case. French military analyzed.

name: Mariana UFO Film
summary: Minor-league baseball manager Nicholas Mariana filmed two bright objects crossing the sky over Great Falls. The film became one of the earliest motion-picture UFO cases examined in the Air Force investigation record.

name: Fort Monmouth Radar Case
summary: Army Signal Corps radar operators tracked fast unknown targets during radar demonstrations at Fort Monmouth. The incident helped revive official Air Force UFO investigation activity leading into Project Blue Book.

name: Tremonton UFO Film
summary: Navy photographer Delbert Newhouse filmed a group of bright objects near Tremonton. The footage was studied alongside the Mariana film as one of the better-known early Project Blue Book photographic cases.

name: Carson Sink Encounter
summary: Two U.S. Air Force colonels flying a B-25 near Carson Sink reported three fast, delta-like objects passing near their aircraft. The report is commonly listed among Project Blue Book unknowns.

name: Val Johnson Incident
summary: Deputy Sheriff Val Johnson reported that a bright light struck his patrol car near Stephen, Minnesota. The incident involved injuries, damaged vehicle glass and lights, and stopped timepieces, making it a notable police physical-trace case.

name: Clarenville RCMP Encounter
summary: Multiple witnesses, including RCMP Constable James Blackwood, observed a brightly lit object over Random Island and Clarenville. The case remains one of Newfoundland's best-known police-witness UFO reports.

name: Emilcin Abduction
summary: Polish farmer Jan Wolski reported being taken aboard a landed craft near Emilcin and examined by short humanoid beings. A memorial later marked the alleged landing site, making it Poland's most famous abduction claim.

name: Calvine UFO Photograph
summary: Two witnesses near Calvine reported seeing and photographing a large diamond-shaped object accompanied by a military aircraft. The case became prominent through UK Ministry of Defence and National Archives material.

name: Alderney Channel Islands Sighting
summary: Aurigny pilot Ray Bowyer, passengers, air traffic control, and another pilot reported unusual bright objects near Alderney. The event generated a detailed civil aviation and scientific review.

name: Lake Michigan Radar Event
summary: Hundreds of western Michigan residents reported unusual lights over Lake Michigan. Police dispatchers contacted the National Weather Service, where radar returns were described as fast-moving unusual targets.

name: Canneto di Caronia Fires
summary: A series of unexplained fires and electrical anomalies affected homes in Canneto di Caronia during 2004-2005, drawing investigation by Italian authorities and scientists. The case is included as an anomalous-events file rather than a direct craft sighting.

name: Morristown UFO Hoax
summary: A series of red-light sightings over Morristown was later admitted to be a staged hoax using balloons and flares. It is useful as a comparison case for witness interpretation and media amplification.

name: Persian Gulf UAP Formation
summary: PURSUE Release 02 includes a Middle East infrared military-platform video described in press coverage as three UAP flying in formation over the Persian Gulf. The archive classifies the released material as unresolved rather than explanatory proof.

name: Iran Four-Object Maritime Formation
summary: Release 02 reporting identifies a 2022 military video showing four unidentified objects moving past vessels on the water off Iran. The case is cataloged here as a released sensor-video item pending deeper review of the original file.

name: Syria Fast-Moving UAP
summary: PURSUE Release 02 coverage describes a 2021 Syria video in which an unidentified object rapidly departs the sensor frame. The archive item is retained as an unresolved UAP record, not as a determination of origin.

name: East China Sea Football-Shaped UAP
summary: News summaries of Release 02 identify an October 2022 video over the East China Sea showing an American-football-shaped object. This entry tracks the released video as a Pacific theater UAP case.

name: Columbus Ohio Infrared UAP
summary: Release 02 reporting describes November 2022 infrared footage likely from a U.S. military platform in the NORTHCOM area, with several UAP observed around Columbus. The case is included as a domestic sensor-video release.

name: Sandia Green Fireballs Investigation
summary: Release 02 includes documentation from the Armed Forces Special Weapons Program and U.S. Air Force concerning 209 reports near Sandia, New Mexico, from 1948 to 1950. The records describe green orbs, discs, fireballs, and related investigation activity near a sensitive military installation.

name: Apollo 12 Light Streaks Debrief
summary: Release 02 includes NASA medical-debrief audio in which Apollo 12 crew members describe light flashes or streaks of light seen during the mission. The globe location is anchored to the mission launch site because the observation was spaceflight audio rather than a ground sighting.

name: Mercury-Atlas 8 White Objects
summary: Release 02 includes NASA audio from Mercury-Atlas 8 in which astronaut Wally Schirra describes small white objects apparently drifting from the capsule and a brief unidentified light at the window. The case is archived as mission audio rather than a terrestrial sighting.
